title: The Night of the Borrowed Stripes
description: At sunset on Borrowed Stripes Night, a zebra lets two stripes loose on the wind. By the waterhole, a tiger is already trying on the first ones.
alt: Two black stripes curl away from a zebra in golden grass. A tiger wears a striped scarf beside a waterhole, with a red sunset behind them.
pairing: An imagined stripe-swapping holiday × a zebra and tiger at a waterhole
